answer: Imagine an orchard where each tree is tended by a different gardener. Each epoch the network hands every identity one cipher, a puzzle sealed with its own past seasons — only its owner can open it, and the opened cipher carries an echo of that owner's history. Ten clones grown from one purse answer with the same echo, the same timing, the same mistakes; the network hears the rhyme and burns all ten bonds at once. One honest tree opens its own cipher and keeps its fruit.
